body: The dim light of dawn filtered through the cracks in the metal fence. The air was heavy with something familiar yet foreign—a mix of animal sounds and distant alarms. I stood rooted, my heart pounding against my chest like some unseen force. Fear clutched at me, tight and relentless. My eyes darted around, searching for an escape route while my mind raced with thoughts of safety.
